items.title: Myth: the 240-hour transit means a round trip
items.caption:
Americans: the 240-hour China stopover is NOT a round trip. It needs an onward ticket to a third country or region — that's the part people miss. US and Canadian passports are on the transit list. Entry rules as of Nov 16, 2026. Rules change, so confirm on the official NIA site before you book. Not visa or legal advice. Want to see what else you still need to prep?
